free_tier.stated: No published quota - Google 'pays for the hosting of these datasets'. Existing hosted sets (Sentinel-2, Landsat, ARCO-ERA5, NEXRAD) run to petabytes.

egress.terms: Free public access to hosted datasets; anonymous API links work without auth.

chaining: Not applicable - this is Google's own catalogue, not an open intake.
limits_note: There is no application form. The only stated route is 'If you have any questions about listing your public dataset on Cloud Storage, please contact us at [address removed]'. Effectively invitation-only, and the catalogue has grown slowly relative to AWS's 300+ PB.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'iaas'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: No published process means no predictable outcome; do not plan around it.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Google pays for the hosting of these datasets'; the entire intake instruction is an email address
catalogue is Google-owned, commercial and government datasets only
